meta.notes: DRAFT until the traffic render draws the carrier's lowered ramp (playtest 3, T4.3): a truck that launches you with no visible ramp would read as a bug, so release builds leave it out and dev and staging builds carry it. Playtest 3 moving road event ("the ramp trucks could be in motion"): a car carrier drives ahead in the outermost lane at 20 m/s on a straight stretch; once a racer is 200 m behind it, its ramp comes down, and catching it from behind launches you off its lip, the faster the bigger. Four serial signs tell the joke first, punchline last.
